vo: You nod off on the couch,
move: First frame / loop target. The stage (same size and place all video): the couch from above, your head (the dot) on the arm rest, glow soft.

vo: then the second you get into bed,
move: The couch morphs into the bed: frame stretches into the bed, cushions into pillows, blanket into the duvet. The head rides along to the pillow.
Head on the pillow; the glow flares and starts to breathe, a little fast.

vo: That's not random. Your bed learned it.
move: Nothing new moves; the glow gets stronger on 'learned'. A held beat.

vo: Every night you lie there trying, your brain pairs the bed with being alert,
move: The bedroom shrinks into the Monday square; Tue–Sun fill in as the same tiny bed, each one lighting up awake as the VO goes. The full week, all awake, by 'alert'.
Signature transition: the week collapses back into one bed, then the head's glow swells until it fills the stage.

vo: like a kitchen that makes you hungry the second you walk in.
move: The glow shrinks back to a dot and the fridge resolves around it. On 'hungry' the door swings open and light falls out toward you.

vo: So staying in bed longer to catch up only makes the link stronger.
move: Glow transition back to bed. On 'longer' the right nightstand grows into a clock; its hands tick hours away. The glow keeps growing.

vo: The fix is called stimulus control.
move: The clock shrinks back into the nightstand. Held: head lit on the pillow.

vo: When trying feels like work, get up.
move: On 'get up' the head leaves the pillow for the floor beside the bed, and the glow cools. The only tag in the video: 'Get up', amber.

vo: Sit somewhere dim, do something dull, and go back when your eyes feel heavy.
move: Glow transition to the armchair. 'Dim': the lamp comes up low. 'Dull': a book drops onto the side table. 'Go back': the glow transition carries you back to the bed, calm.

vo: Take the two-minute sleep quiz in our bio to find your pattern, for nights when—
move: The stage flips over (same size and place): the quiz is on the back. Start is tapped on 'find your pattern'. On 'for nights when' it flips again and lands on the couch, frame 0.
